title: Set alerts from Anomaly Detector (Generally Available)

content.text: Set alerts directly from Anomaly Detector lets you create an alert from a published anomaly detector configuration without switching to Real-Time Hub. For more information, see Anomaly detection in Real-Time Intelligence.
